in Sydney, and leifsWords quoting him. In the same commit, rewrite (never delete or weaken) the four tests pinned to
the refusal: galxe-desk/scripts/decision.test.mjs, the "committed decision" test in ledger.test.mjs, and the two in
do-card.test.mjs (galxe-claim SKILL.md names them). The arithmetic is in docs/decision-2026-10-31.json.
